info.title: YDot IAM API
info.description:
Identity and access management for the YDot platform.

**Tenancy.** A BusinessUnit is the platform root; each Organisation is a Tenant on its own subdomain. The Organisation a request operates in comes from the signed token or the host name — never from a body, a query string or a header.

**SuperAdmin** operates at global scope with no Organisation of its own and selects one per session; selecting does not change the account's ownership.

**Envelope.** Every response is `{ success, message, data, errors, errorCode, timestamp }`, including failures.

parameters.name: X-Tenant
parameters.description: Development only, loopback only: the Organisation subdomain to operate in (for example "ten1"). Ignored on any non-loopback request, and always outranked by the tenant_id claim on a signed token.
